name: [🎃] Bike Universe
desc:
👋 Welcome to Bike Universe!

How to Play:
🏍️ Ride Bikes around the map
🚴‍♀️ Collect many new bikes (Dirt, Electric, Pedal)
💰 Earn money from riding, wheelies and tricks
⬆️ Tune and customise your bike
🏁 Race your friends

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players

"The BEST Bike game on Roblox."
